# Test FIT fixtures

Committed binaries are generated by:

```text
cd python
py -3.12 tests/generate_fixtures.py
```

| File | RecordingStrategy | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `stroke-boundary.fit` | 1 StrokeBoundary | One record per stroke; core developer fields |
| `gps-update.fit` | 2 GPSUpdate | Repeated `total_cycles` then a jump of 2 |

## rowingdata golden file

`rowingdata` documents `testdata/rowingdata_standard_example.fit` as a multi-lap
reference with in-stroke curves. That file is not copied here: it is not present
in the local `rowingdata` checkout, and it contains Level 3 curve fields this
package does not yet model. Interop tests look for it next to this repo
(`../rowingdata/testdata/rowingdata_standard_example.fit`) and skip if missing.

To regenerate that golden file, from the `rowingdata` repository:

```text
python tools/build_example_standard_fit.py
```
